description: This script fetches prompts from specified URLs, processes the data, and saves it as a JSON file. It manages both Chinese and English prompts, with functions to handle HTTP requests, timeouts, and data formatting.

methods.name: timeoutPromise
methods.description: Creates a promise that rejects after a specified timeout
